source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 13 (PDF 4-17), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 13 (Thermal Physics) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is thermal physics? Which two areas of knowledge does it need?
(Thermal physics kya hai? Is ke liye kin do shobon ka ilm zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thermal physics heat, work, temperature aur energy ki doosri shaklon ke taalluq se bahas karti hai. Is ke liye statistical mechanics aur kinetic theory of gases ka ilm zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Thermal physics is an important area of study

blocks.prompt:
2 Differentiate between a macroscopic system and a microscopic system.
(Macroscopic aur microscopic system mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Macroscopic system mein bohat se atoms/molecules hote hain; microscopic system mein aik atom ya molecule.

book_ref.quote: Macroscopic systems have properties such as temperature and pressure

rows: Bara system jis mein bohat se atoms ya molecules hon.
Aik atom ya molecule par mushtamil system.
Properties: temperature aur pressure (poore system ki thermal properties).
Maadde ki molecular fitrat ke zikr ke baghair parha ja sakta hai.
Aik akele atom ya molecule se bahas karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3 Name four daily-life applications of the kinetic theory of gases.
(Kinetic theory of gases ki chaar rozmarra applications ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Automobile engines, turbines, pumps aur air conditioners (khurak ki tayyari aur mahol bhi).

book_ref.quote: There are number of applications of the kinetic theory of gases in daily life

blocks.prompt:
4 Define Brownian motion.
(Brownian motion ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Brownian motion fluid (maa'e) mein lataktay chhote zarraat (maslan paani mein pollen) ki be-tarteeb (zig-zag) harkat hai jo fluid ke molecules ki takkar se hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Brownian motion is the random motion of small particles suspended in a fluid

blocks.prompt:
5 What did Robert Brown observe, and when?
(Robert Brown ne kya dekha aur kab?)
blocks.explanation: 1827 mein botanist (nabatat ke maahir) Robert Brown ne microscope se dekha ke liquid mein pollen ke nanhay zarraat be-tarteeb ghoom rahe the. Baad mein sabit hua ke yeh molecular harkat ka asar hai.

book_ref.quote: Robert Brown, a botanist observed under microscope

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein saal 1927 chhapa hai jo ghalat hai; sahih saal 1827 hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
6 Why does a gas molecule follow a zig-zag path?
(Gas ka molecule zig-zag raasta kyun ikhtiyar karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har takkar ke baad molecule ka raasta badal jata hai. Baar baar takkar aur har takkar mein momentum aur energy ke tabadle se raasta be-tarteeb ya zig-zag ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A molecule in a gas changes its path after collision with another molecule.

blocks.prompt:
7 How does the mass (size) of particles affect the speed of Brownian motion?
(Zarraat ka mass (size) Brownian motion ki speed par kya asar daalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Momentum ki muntaqili zarraat ke mass ke ulat mutanasib hai, is liye halke (chhote) zarraat takkar se zyada speed paa kar tez chalte hain.

book_ref.quote: We know that the transfer of momentum is inversely proportional to the mass of the particles.

blocks.prompt:
8 What is viscosity? How does it affect Brownian motion?
(Viscosity kya hai? Yeh Brownian motion par kya asar daalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Viscosity (gaarha-pan) fluid ki andaruni ragar, yani bahao ki mazahmat hai. Zarraat ki speed viscosity ke ulat mutanasib hai; kam viscosity par Brownian movement tez hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The speed of the particles is inversely proportional to the viscosity of the fluid.

blocks.prompt:
9 Who explained Brownian motion and who verified the explanation experimentally?
(Brownian motion ki wazahat kis ne ki aur tajurbe se tasdeeq kis ne ki?)
blocks.explanation: Albert Einstein ne 1905 mein molecules ki madad se pollen ki harkat ki wazahat ki. French physicist J Perrin ne 1908 mein tajurbe se tasdeeq ki aur 1926 ka Nobel Prize paaya.

book_ref.quote: which earned him the 1926 Nobel Prize in physics

blocks.prompt:
10 Why is Brownian motion called a simple model of randomness?
(Brownian motion ko randomness ka saada model kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke zarraat be-tarteeb molecular takkaron ki wajah se be-qaida simton mein chalte hain; yeh harkat randomness (be-tarteebi) aur chaos ko bayan karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Brownian motion describes randomness and chaos

blocks.prompt:
11 What does the kinetic theory of gases describe? How does gas pressure arise according to it?
(Kinetic theory of gases kya bayan karti hai? Is ke mutabiq gas ka pressure kaise paida hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh gas ki molecular banawat aur molecules ki harkat bayan karti hai. Zarraat aapas mein aur deewaron se takrate hain, is se pressure paida hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The kinetic theory of gases describes the molecular composition of the gas and their motion.

blocks.prompt:
12 State any four basic assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases.
(Kinetic theory of gases ke koi chaar bunyadi mafrooze likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Gas bohat se nanhay gol zarraat par mushtamil hai jo apne size ke muqable mein door door hain. (2) Zarraat musalsal tez aur be-tarteeb harkat mein hain. (3) Takkarein bilkul elastic hain. (4) Takkar ke ilawa zarraat mein na kashish hai na dafa; average K.E. temperature par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: However, the basic assumptions are:

blocks.prompt:
13 Define mean free path.
(Mean free path ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mean free path woh average faasla hai jo harkat karta zarra aisi takkar se pehle tay kare jo us ki simt ya energy ko kaafi badal de.

book_ref.quote: The mean free path is average distance a moving particle covered

blocks.prompt:
14 Why is the volume of gas particles neglected in the kinetic theory?
(Kinetic theory mein gas zarraat ka volume kyun nazar-andaz kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gas zarraat nanhay aur apne size ke muqable mein bohat door hain, is liye un ka apna volume khaali jagah ke muqable mein na-qabil-e-zikr hai.

book_ref.quote: Volume of the gas particles is negligible compared to the volume of the empty spaces.

blocks.prompt:
15 Name the transport properties described by the kinetic theory of gases.
(Kinetic theory of gases jin transport properties ko bayan karti hai un ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Viscosity, thermal conductivity aur diffusivity. (Yeh temperature, volume aur pressure bhi bayan karti hai.)

book_ref.quote: It also defines properties such as temperature, volume and pressure

blocks.text: 13.3 Pressure in a Gas and Derivation of PV = ⅓Nm<v²>

blocks.prompt:
16 Define the pressure of a gas on the basis of the kinetic theory.
(Kinetic theory ki bunyad par gas ke pressure ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Molecules deewaron se takra kar har takkar mein momentum ki tabdeeli se force lagate hain. In takkaron se deewaron par fi unit area force gas ka pressure hai.

book_ref.quote: When gas molecules strike the walls, they exert a force on them due to the change in momentum during each collision.

blocks.prompt:
17 Show that the ideal gas law PV = nRT can be written as PV = Nk_BT.
(Sabit karein ke ideal gas law PV = nRT ko PV = Nk_BT likha ja sakta hai.)
blocks.explanation: R = N_Ak_B se PV = nN_Ak_BT. Moles n = N/N_A, is liye PV = (N/N_A)N_Ak_BT = Nk_BT.

book_ref.quote: where P is the pressure, n is number of moles, R is general gas constant

blocks.prompt:
18 How many molecules are there in 2.0 × 10⁻³ m³ of an ideal gas at 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa and 290 K? (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹)
(1.0 × 10⁵ Pa aur 290 K par ideal gas ke 2.0 × 10⁻³ m³ mein kitne molecules hain? (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: (N_A = 6.02 × 10²³ molecules) is the Avogadro number

blocks.prompt:
19 Find the change in momentum of a molecule that strikes a wall with velocity vₓ and rebounds elastically.
(Deewar se vₓ velocity se takra kar elastic tor par lautne wale molecule ke momentum ki tabdeeli maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Ibtidai momentum = mvₓ; aakhri = −mvₓ. Δp = −mvₓ − mvₓ = −2mvₓ; miqdaar 2mvₓ.

book_ref.quote: It rebounds elastically in the opposite direction having velocity –v

blocks.prompt:
20 Why is the time between two consecutive collisions of a molecule with the same wall equal to 2L/vₓ?
(Aik hi deewar se molecule ki do lagataar takkaron ka darmiyani waqt 2L/vₓ kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Deewar se takra kar molecule L saamne wali deewar tak aur L wapas aata hai, kul 2L, speed vₓ se. Is liye Δt = 2L/vₓ.

book_ref.quote: It moves back and forth, colliding at regular intervals with the walls

blocks.prompt:
21 A molecule of mass 4.0 × 10⁻²⁶ kg moves with vₓ = 300 m s⁻¹ in a cubical box of side 0.050 m. Find the average force it exerts on one wall.
(4.0 × 10⁻²⁶ kg ka molecule 0.050 m side ke cube mein vₓ = 300 m s⁻¹ se chal raha hai. Aik deewar par average force nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: This molecule has mass m, and is moving with speed

blocks.prompt:
22 Why are velocities squared before averaging in the kinetic theory?
(Kinetic theory mein average se pehle velocities ka square kyun kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molecule vₓ se takrata aur −vₓ se lautta hai, saada average sifar aata hai. Square karne se har term musbat ho jati hai aur <vₓ²> sifar nahi rehta.

book_ref.quote: This means simple average does not work here.

blocks.prompt:
23 Define root mean square (rms) velocity.
(Root mean square (rms) velocity ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: rms velocity velocities ke squares ke average ka square root hai: vᵣₘₛ = √<v²>, jahan <v²> = (v₁² + v₂² + ... + v_N²)/N.

book_ref.quote: is known as the root mean square (rms) velocity and is written as:

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki Eq. (13.8) mein average square root ke baad liya gaya hai jo ghalat hai; pehle squares ka average, phir square root: √<v²> (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
24 Three molecules have speeds 2, 4 and 6 m s⁻¹. Find their average speed and rms speed.
(Teen molecules ki speeds 2, 4 aur 6 m s⁻¹ hain. Average speed aur rms speed nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: In order to avoid this zero, we need to do the square of the velocities before averaging.

blocks.prompt:
25 Why is <vₓ²> = <v²>/3 for a gas?
(Gas ke liye <vₓ²> = <v²>/3 kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: <v²> = <vₓ²> + <v_y²> + <v_z²>. Molecules teeno simton mein yaksaan average speed se chalte hain, is liye <v²> = 3<vₓ²>, yani <vₓ²> = <v²>/3.

book_ref.quote: Since gas molecules are moving randomly and have the same average speed in all three directions.

blocks.prompt:
26 Write the pressure of a gas in terms of its density and find the rms speed when P = 2.0 × 10⁵ Pa and ρ = 1.5 kg m⁻³.
(Gas ka pressure density ki shakal mein likhein aur P = 2.0 × 10⁵ Pa, ρ = 1.5 kg m⁻³ par rms speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: P = ⅓ρ<v²>, is liye vᵣₘₛ = √(3P/ρ) = √(4.0 × 10⁵) = 6.3 × 10² m s⁻¹.

book_ref.quote: This is the pressure of the gas molecules on the wall.

blocks.prompt:
27 Starting from PV = ⅓Nm<v²>, show that P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T>.
(PV = ⅓Nm<v²> se shuru kar ke sabit karein ke P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T>.)
blocks.explanation: P = (N/3V)m<v²> = ⅔(N/V)<½mv²>. N/V = N₀ (fi unit volume molecules) aur <½mv²> = <K.E._T> rakhne se P = ⅔N₀<K.E._T>.

book_ref.quote: Rearranging the pressure, Eq. (13.13) for P, and substituting the density

blocks.prompt:
28 A carbon dioxide molecule has a mass of 44 u. Find its mass in kilograms. (1 u = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg)
(Carbon dioxide molecule ka mass 44 u hai. Kilogram mein mass nikalein. (1 u = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg))

book_ref.quote: Mass of oxygen O₂ = 32 × 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 5.3 × 10⁻²⁶ kg

blocks.prompt:
29 Find the rms speed of helium atoms of mass 6.64 × 10⁻²⁷ kg at 300 K. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹)
(300 K par 6.64 × 10⁻²⁷ kg mass wale helium atoms ki rms speed nikalein. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: What is the rms speed of air molecules (O₂ and N₂) at room temperature e.g. 25 °C?

blocks.prompt:
30 How does the rms speed of air molecules at room temperature compare with the speed of sound in air?
(Kamre ke temperature par hawa ke molecules ki rms speed awaz ki speed se kaise muqabla karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: 25 °C par rms speeds taqreeban 481 m s⁻¹ (O₂) aur 515 m s⁻¹ (N₂) hain, jo awaz ki speed (taqreeban 340 m s⁻¹) se kahin zyada hain.

book_ref.quote: The speed of air molecules is much greater than the speed of sound which is about 340 m s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
31 Explain the popping of popcorn on the basis of the kinetic theory of gases.
(Kinetic theory of gases ki bunyad par popcorn ke phatne ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Garam karne par daane mein qaid nami bhaap ban jati hai. Andar pressure barh kar chhilka phaar deta hai, lesdar (gelatinous) starch bahar aata hai jo thanda ho kar sakht ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: When popcorn kernel is heated, the moisture trapped in popcorn kernel becomes steam.

blocks.prompt:
32 Why does the pressure inside a car tyre rise when air is pumped into it?
(Gaari ke tyre mein hawa bharne se andar pressure kyun barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hawa bharne se tyre ke mehdood volume mein molecules barh jate hain, deewaron se takkarein zyada hoti hain aur pressure barhta hai. Yahi pressure tyre ko sakhti deta hai.

book_ref.quote: more molecules result in frequent molecular collisions with tyre's walls due to limited volume

blocks.text: 13.4 Average Translational Kinetic Energy of a Gas

blocks.prompt:
33 What is the Boltzmann constant? Give its value and its relation with R and N_A.
(Boltzmann constant kya hai? Is ki qeemat aur R aur N_A se taalluq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Boltzmann constant fi molecule gas constant hai: k_B = R/N_A = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹ (ya 8.62 × 10⁻⁵ eV K⁻¹).

book_ref.quote: However, M/m is simply Avogadro's number i.e. N_A = M m⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
34 Write the expression for the rms speed of gas molecules in terms of R and T, and show how it depends on temperature.
(Gas molecules ki rms speed ka formula R aur T ki shakal mein likhein aur temperature par us ka inhesaar dikhayein.)
blocks.explanation: nRT = (N/3)mvᵣₘₛ² barabar karne se vᵣₘₛ = √(3RT/mN_A), jahan mN_A aik mole ka mass hai. Is liye vᵣₘₛ ∝ √T.

book_ref.quote: We have calculated the pressure of the gas molecule

blocks.prompt:
35 Write the relation between the average translational kinetic energy of gas molecules and the absolute temperature. What does it show?
(Gas molecules ki average translational K.E. aur absolute temperature ka taalluq likhein. Yeh kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: <K.E._T> = ½mvᵣₘₛ² = (3/2)k_BT. Average translational K.E. aik constant × T hai, is liye gas ka temperature molecules ki average translational K.E. ka seedha paimana hai.

book_ref.quote: the temperature of a gas is a direct measure of the average translational kinetic energy of its molecules

blocks.prompt:
36 Find the average translational kinetic energy of a gas molecule at 227 °C. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹)
(227 °C par gas molecule ki average translational K.E. nikalein. (k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: is given by a simple constant times the temperature

blocks.prompt:
37 Define the electron volt and give its value in joules.
(Electron volt ki definition likhein aur joules mein qeemat batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik electron volt us electron ki K.E. hai jo aik volt ke potential farq se accelerate ho. 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J. Yeh k_BT jaisi bohat chhoti energies ke liye istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The electron volt is the kinetic energy of an electron

blocks.prompt:
38 Find the value of k_BT at 1000 K in electron volts. (k_B = 8.62 × 10⁻⁵ eV K⁻¹)
(1000 K par k_BT ki qeemat electron volts mein nikalein. (k_B = 8.62 × 10⁻⁵ eV K⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: so at room temperature, value of k_BT

blocks.prompt:
39 The absolute temperature of a gas is tripled. What happens to (i) the average translational K.E. and (ii) the rms speed of its molecules?
(Gas ka absolute temperature teen guna kar diya jaye. (i) average translational K.E. aur (ii) molecules ki rms speed par kya asar hoga?)
blocks.explanation: (i) <K.E.> ∝ T, is liye teen guna. (ii) vᵣₘₛ ∝ √T, is liye √3 = 1.73 guna.

book_ref.quote: In this equation, 1/2mv²ₘᵣₛ is the average translational kinetic energy

blocks.prompt:
40 Find the ratio of the rms speeds of the molecules of a gas at 600 K and at 150 K.
(Aik gas ke molecules ki rms speeds ka 600 K aur 150 K par tanasub nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: vᵣₘₛ ∝ √T, is liye v₆₀₀/v₁₅₀ = √(600/150) = 2. Tanasub 2 : 1.

book_ref.quote: We rewrite the pressure equation as

blocks.prompt:
41 How does the kinetic theory help in protecting the environment?
(Kinetic theory mahol (environment) ki hifazat mein kaise madad karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kinetic theory pollutants (aaloodgi ke ajza) aur atmosphere ke taamul ko samajhne mein madad deti hai. Is ilm se hawa ke maiyaar ki nigrani ke systems banaye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: This knowledge is used to develop the systems to monitor the quality of air.

blocks.prompt:
42 What is statistical physics? Why is it needed for a gas?
(Statistical physics kya hai? Gas ke liye is ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Statistical physics physics ki woh shaakh hai jo probability theory (imkaan ka nazariya) istemal karti hai. Gas mein bohat se molecules mukhtalif speeds aur energy states mein hote hain, is liye statistical bayan zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: For large number of molecule, we use statistical physics.

blocks.prompt:
43 State the Boltzmann distribution law and define the Boltzmann factor.
(Boltzmann distribution law bayan karein aur Boltzmann factor ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: N₂/N₁ = e^(−ΔE/k_BT), jahan N₁, N₂ nichli aur oonchi energy states ki aabadi aur ΔE = E₂ − E₁ hai. e^(−ΔE/k_BT) Boltzmann factor kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: This equation is known as the Boltzmann distribution law and is important

blocks.prompt:
44 Why do more particles reside in lower energy states than in higher ones?
(Nichli energy states mein oonchi states se zyada zarraat kyun hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi energy state mein molecules milne ka imkaan −E/k_BT ke mutabiq exponentially ghat'ta hai. Oonchi state ke liye ΔE > 0, is liye N₂/N₁ < 1; nichli states mein zyada zarraat.

book_ref.quote: It states that the probability of finding the molecules in a particular energy state

blocks.prompt:
45 Two energy levels differ by ΔE = 3k_BT. Find the ratio of the populations N₂/N₁.
(Do energy levels ka farq ΔE = 3k_BT hai. Aabadi ka tanasub N₂/N₁ nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: N₂/N₁ = e^(−3) = 0.050. Oonchi level par nichli level ki aabadi ka sirf taqreeban 5% hai.

book_ref.quote: Boltzmann constant is also related to the population of atoms in two levels.

blocks.prompt:
46 The speed of a gas molecule changes at every collision. How then can we speak of its average kinetic energy at temperature T?
(Gas molecule ki speed har takkar par badalti hai. Phir temperature T par us ki average K.E. ki baat kaise ki ja sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Molecule har second arbon takkarein khata hai aur har takkar speed aur K.E. badalti hai. Itni takkaron ka average lene par kinetic theory muqarrar average deti hai: E_av = (3/2)k_BT.

book_ref.quote: Each collision changes the speed of molecule thereby changing the kinetic energy

blocks.prompt:
47 What was Maxwell's contribution to the kinetic theory?
(Kinetic theory mein Maxwell ka kya hissa tha?)
blocks.explanation: 1860 mein James Clerk Maxwell ne thermal equilibrium par molecular speeds ki taqseem ka formula nikala. Taqreeban 60 saal baad tajurbat ne us ki tasdeeq ki.

book_ref.quote: In 1860 James Clark Maxwell (1831–1879) derived an expression

blocks.prompt:
48 What are neutron stars? Why are they difficult to study?
(Neutron stars kya hain? Inhein parhna mushkil kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neutron stars kainaat ki ghani tareen ashya mein se hain, sirf black holes se peeche; un ka maadda degenerate gas ki tarah hai. Qareeb tareen bhi kai parsec door hain aur taqatwar gravity inhein model karna mushkil banati hai.

book_ref.quote: Neutron stars are among the densest known objects in the universe

blocks.prompt:
49 What are pulsars? How is their radiation believed to be produced?
(Pulsars kya hain? Un ki radiation kaise paida hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pulsars nisbatan jawan, tez ghoomne wale neutron stars hain jo radiation ki shuaaein chhorte hain. Taqatwar magnetic fields maadde ko magnetic poles ki taraf le jati hain to radiation paida hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Many of the neutron stars observed so far are relatively young and rotate rapidly

blocks.prompt:
50 Why does the magnetic field of a star become very strong when it collapses into a neutron star?
(Neutron star bante waqt star ki magnetic field bohat taqatwar kyun ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Core ke sukarne par mass aur field dono dab jate hain. Magnetic field lines qareeb aa jati hain, aur qareeb lines ka matlab taqatwar field hai.

book_ref.quote: Magnetic fields represented by field lines become stronger

blocks.prompt:
51 How was the Sun formed?
(Sooraj kaise bana?)
blocks.explanation: Taqreeban 4.6 arab saal pehle sooraj gas aur gard ke bare baadal (solar nebula) se bana. Gravitational sukar se markaz garam hua aur protostar bana; core bohat garam hua to hydrogen ka helium mein fusion shuru hua.

book_ref.quote: The Sun is the nearest star to Earth and the main source of heat and light for our planet.

blocks.prompt:
52 Name the life stages of the Sun in order. In which stage is it at present?
(Sooraj ki zindagi ke marahil tarteeb se likhein. Woh is waqt kis marhale mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nebula → protostar → main sequence → red giant → planetary nebula → white dwarf. Is waqt sooraj main sequence marhale mein hai aur hydrogen ko helium mein badal raha hai.

book_ref.quote: The life stages of the Sun are

blocks.prompt:
53 Why is the Sun important in thermal physics?
(Thermal physics mein sooraj ki kya ahmiyat hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sooraj bohat bari heat energy ka qudrati zariya hai jo hydrogen ke helium mein fusion se banti hai, aur yeh energy zyada tar radiation (ishaa'at) se muntaqil karta hai.

book_ref.quote: In thermal physics, the Sun is important because

blocks.prompt:
54 A star has mass 1.5 × 10³⁰ kg, radius 8 × 10⁸ m and internal pressure 2 × 10¹⁴ Pa. Using P_g ≈ GM²/R⁴, decide whether it will expand or contract. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²)
(Aik star ka mass 1.5 × 10³⁰ kg, radius 8 × 10⁸ m aur andaruni pressure 2 × 10¹⁴ Pa hai. P_g ≈ GM²/R⁴ se batayein ke phailega ya sukrega. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²))
blocks.explanation: P_g = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ × 2.25 × 10⁶⁰/4.10 × 10³⁵ = 3.7 × 10¹⁴ Pa. Yeh 2 × 10¹⁴ Pa se zyada hai, gravity jeet'ti hai aur star sukrega.

book_ref.quote: A star has mass 2 × 10³⁰ kg and radius 7 × 10⁸ m.

blocks.prompt:
55 What is stellar evolution? On what does the life of a star depend?
(Stellar evolution kya hai? Star ki zindagi kis par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stellar evolution (sitaron ka irtiqa) yeh hai ke star waqt ke saath kaise badalta hai. Umrein chand million se kharbon saal tak hain aur star ki zindagi us ke mass par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: Stellar evolution deals with the star changes over the time.

blocks.prompt:
56 Which stars live longest and which live shortest?
(Kaun se stars sab se lambi aur kaun se sab se chhoti umr paate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se kam mass wale stars (red dwarfs) sab se lambi umr, kharbon saal tak, paate hain. Sab se zyada mass wale stars sirf chand million saal jeete hain.

book_ref.quote: the most massive stars live only a few million years

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ne likha hai ke sab se bhaari stars sab se lamba jeete hain; yeh ghalat hai. Sahih: sab se halke (red dwarfs) sab se lamba jeete hain (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
57 How does a cloud of gas and dust become a star?
(Gas aur gard ka baadal star kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nebula (molecular cloud) sukarta hai; zarraat ki K.E. barhne se density aur temperature barhte hain (K.E. ∝ T) aur protostar banta hai. Million saalon baad equilibrium par pohanch kar star ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: After a millions of years, these proto-stars can become a star

blocks.prompt:
58 Write the hydrostatic equation of a star and state what the negative sign shows.
(Star ki hydrostatic equation likhein aur manfi nishan ka matlab batayein.)
blocks.explanation: ΔP/Δr = −GMᵣρᵣ/r², jahan Mᵣ radius r ke andar ka mass aur ρᵣ r par density hai. Manfi nishan batata hai ke pressure bahar ki taraf kam hota hai jab ke gravity andar kheenchti hai.

book_ref.quote: This condition is described by the hydrostatic equation;

blocks.prompt:
59 What is the role of nuclear fusion in the life of a star?
(Star ki zindagi mein nuclear fusion ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Core ka temperature barhne par hydrogen nuclei mil kar helium banate hain aur bohat energy nikalti hai. Yeh energy star ko zindagi ke zyada hisse mein chalati aur gravitational collapse ke khilaf equilibrium qaim rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: This process releases an immense amount of energy

blocks.prompt:
60 What happens in the red giant stage of a star?
(Star ke red giant marhale mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Temperature barhne aur core ki banawat badalne se star phail kar red giant banta hai. Kam az kam aadhe sooraj jitne mass wale stars helium fusion se carbon aur oxygen banate hain; bhaari stars iron tak fusion jaari rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: the star may expand significantly to become a red giant

blocks.prompt:
61 Differentiate between the end of a low or intermediate mass star and that of a star about ten times the Sun's mass.
(Kam ya darmiyane mass wale star aur sooraj se taqreeban das guna mass wale star ke anjaam mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Kam/darmiyane mass wale stars white dwarf bante hain; bohat bhaari stars supernova se khatam hote hain.

book_ref.quote: In low and intermediate mass stars

header: Kam ya darmiyane mass wala star
Sooraj se taqreeban das guna mass wala star
rows: Core sukar kar ghana white dwarf banta hai.
Bahar ki tehein khala mein phenk di jati hain (planetary nebula).
Be-amal iron core gravity se collapse karta hai.
Baqiya: neutron star ya black hole.

blocks.prompt:
62 Why has no red dwarf yet completed its life cycle, and what will it finally become?
(Kisi red dwarf ne abhi tak life cycle mukammal kyun nahi kiya, aur woh aakhir mein kya banega?)
blocks.explanation: Red dwarfs ka mass kam aur fuel ka istemal bohat kifayati hai, is liye irtiqa bohat aahista hai; kainaat abhi itni purani nahi. Models ke mutabiq woh garam aur roshan ho kar aakhir kam mass wale white dwarf banenge.

book_ref.quote: Red dwarf stars, due to their low mass and highly efficient fuel consumption

blocks.prompt:
63 What is a parsec? Express 10 parsec in kilometres.
(Parsec kya hai? 10 parsec ko kilometres mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Parsec falkiyat daanon ki faasle ki unit hai; 1 parsec ≈ 3.26 light years ≈ 31 trillion km (3.1 × 10¹³ km). Is liye 10 parsec ≈ 3.1 × 10¹⁴ km.

book_ref.quote: A parsec is a unit of distance that is used by astronomers

blocks.prompt:
64 Differentiate between a white dwarf and a neutron star.
(White dwarf aur neutron star mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: White dwarf kam/darmiyane mass wale star ka ghana core hai; neutron star bohat bhaari star ke supernova ke baad bachta hai.

book_ref.quote: leading to the formation of dense remnants such as neutron stars or black holes

rows: Kam ya darmiyane mass wale star ka core sukar kar banta hai.
Sooraj se das guna mass wale star ka iron core supernova mein collapse kar ke banta hai.
Bahar ki tehein planetary nebula banati hain.
Sooraj aur red dwarfs ka aakhri marhala.
Ghani tareen ashya mein se, sirf black holes se peeche; jawan neutron stars pulsars ho sakte hain.
